description: Genuine captures of Livara Essentials, Settings, Studio, native apps, a branded installer requirements screen, nested GNOME desktop, source-built Code, official Tor initial UI and editable fonts. No newly booted ISO, complete disk installation or physical hardware qualification is shown.

captures.context: Actual nested GNOME46 compositor with Livara wallpaper, branding and floating glass dock. This is a minimal source preview under software rendering; no ISO boot.

not_captured: The normal Livara Browser Gecko engine has not been fully compiled or launched here, so there is no genuine full-browser screenshot.
Chat is represented by a clearly labeled earlier native capture. Its current preview could not start because the container blocks a required WebKit sandbox mount; the sandbox was preserved.
These captures cover the major implemented areas, rather than every tool, dialog or customization. Software-rendered nested previews do not establish hardware performance.

Earlier Settings and Center captures predate the App icons navigation item; the App icons capture shows the current addition. Their earlier qualification records retain the source hashes tested at that time.

No newly booted ISO, boot splash, login session, completed disk installation, physical RTX card or Core Ultra7 machine was captured. Installer requirements UI is captured; encrypted install and reboot are unqualified.

Earlier Settings and Center captures predate the Feature hub navigation item. Their previous qualification records describe their capture-time source snapshots. All new Essentials pages are captured from the current source.
